source: Audit A03 targets explicit per-request ownership, named transitions and separation of session/execution/diagnostics; it does not require every stateless helper to move to a different class.
decision: Keeping partial classes and four private phase methods is not independently blocking when state ownership and dependencies are proved. Do not replace this assessment by file-size budgets.

dependencies: _traceSink: diagnostic callback; protection must be verified
runnerAssessment.currentIssue: Trace-sink guard corrected and statically re-reviewed, with per-run CollectorHealth and aggregated finally event; real RunAsync observer tests await the next full gate. Session-ownership bug is being handled separately by the assigned agent.
runnerAssessment.fields: Only five readonly instance dependency fields on reusable runner; mutable execution/evidence/iteration values allocated per invocation.

criteria.proof: Compiled readonly field contract and real overlapping ExecuteAsync budget contexts added in SourceBackedBudgetContextIsolationTests.cs; one request is rejected before simulated I/O, the other completes with exact usage and parent context restored. Tests written, not executed by reviewer; next client gate required.
criteria.required: No current-run question, evidence, counters, selections, budget or terminal state stored on reusable runner. Scoped contexts restore parent on success, failure and cancellation.

criteria.proof: Barrier-based test through real RagChatAgent: session A pending, load B, complete A; assert B state unchanged and A result/diagnostics remain A. Include cancellation/error and preference reset semantics.
criteria.required: The actual session identity selects or owns memory. Loading/resetting another session during an old pending request cannot change its snapshot, and an old completion cannot write mode/evidence/trace into the newly active session.

criteria.proof: AgentIterationPipelineTests + AgentRunLifecycleTests; static preservation of original 83 ordered statements and control targets; actual caller behavior tests.
criteria.required: The four ordered phases return Advance/Continue/Stop/Complete; only the first non-Advance result controls the outer loop; exact one terminal lifecycle outcome and no phase after completion/failure/cancellation.

criteria.proof: Throwing phase observer, event sink and trace-sink tests; actual success, business exception and cancellation keep their outcomes; no current-run counter placed on shared runner.
criteria.required: Trace/progress diagnostic failures preserve the original answer/exception and are counted visibly for the correct request. A collector failure is not a model failure.

criteria.proof: Actual factory and compiled call graph; complete normal Release and offline suites.
criteria.required: Production composes the same portable lifecycle/pipeline/planners and typed source/job contracts tested offline; no empty Owner wrapper is counted as an extraction.

criteria.proof: Real documentary adapter tests through captured HTTP handlers; no independent memory selection, no implicit session from active UI when processing an old request.
criteria.required: Mutable data is owned by request/session explicitly. Readonly dependency fields alone are not a thread-safety guarantee: adapter ownership and lifetimes must be documented/tested.

adapters.namedResolver: Readonly catalog/identity-hydrator ports backed by ApiClient; dictionaries/counts are local to ResolveAsync.

documentaryExecutor.optionalLaterExtraction: Extract a stable documentary operations port implemented by current legacy code and inject it together with request-scoped observation/progress and immutable limits. Move search/docRef policy families with causal tests; do not create a class that only forwards to an Owner.
actualResponsibilities: Document locator normalization and named reference completion
documentaryExecutor.acceptableCondition: Owner lifetime is per run and memory is a captured session owner/snapshot. Explicitly retain this as a legacy transport adapter until search/docRef policy families migrate.
documentaryExecutor.ownerDependency: Broad _owner exists, but this adapter has real behavior and is not an empty facade.
documentaryExecutor.whyNotApiOnly: Calling ApiClient directly now would bypass existing search/multi-search scope, identity resolution and normalization policies.

adapters.llm: Factory passes native ISourceBackedAgentLlmClient directly; no Orchestrator forwarding wrapper.

nonBlockingDebt: Large aggregate of stateless helpers remains a maintainability concentration; track it under structural migration with measured downward budgets.

Four private phase methods can be the internal implementation of one run service when their state/inputs/control are explicit. Separate classes are warranted when they own an independent policy or mutable lifecycle, not merely to reduce the nameplate line count.
Further candidates include candidate/audit checkpoint state, semantic selection/repair state and documentary transport, migrated one bounded behavior at a time if independent contracts emerge.
closureRule: Close A03 after C1-C6 evidence is present and the two concrete trace/session bugs are corrected. Report remaining stateless aggregation explicitly as inherited maintainability debt; do not claim overall architectural perfection or semantic/model acceptance.
